name: roots_compressor_10l
title: Roots compressor, 10 L (exercise 2 bis)
summary: Teaching exercise for a 10 L Roots compressor tested at 1.4 bar discharge, with a volumetric efficiency of 85 % and a mechanical efficiency of 95 %. The equation window is that test point, with an inlet orifice and a leakage nozzle.

verification.notes: max_rel_diff and checks concern the variant roots_compressor_10l_no_inlet_drop (34/34 after a constant h/s reference shift of the 8 enthalpy/entropy values; raw compare_solution.py: 8 differ, 26 agree at rtol 1e-3; solved with its .initials). Native file re-run on 0.4.0@9768373: still block 16, Newton iteration 100, residual 3.43807. Details of the 0.3.0@ae7946e native analysis: CoolSolve 0.3.0 binary mtime 2026-10-15 20:23:51 is commit ae7946e. The same residual 3.438 was first seen on f5b79cd. With the shipped initials, block 16 (6 variables: C_thr, V_dot_thr, v_thr, h_thr, T_thr, P_thr) stops at Newton iteration 100, residual 3.438073. Without initials the line search fails at iteration 0, residual 1038.346181. The raw stored initials (EES enthalpies, P_thr = -74168.5 Pa) also stop at iteration 100, residual 20599.127227. A sonic, CoolProp-consistent start of the same six equations, run through Newton, TrustRegion, LevenbergMarquardt, BisectionND, Homotopy and Partitioned, stalls near residual 0.024. On ideal-gas Air the orifice mass flow peaks near 0.463 kg/s at about 52.8 kPa; the fresh-charge flow fixed by epsilon_v is 0.505 kg/s. At 20 °C and 1e5 Pa, CoolSolve enthalpy is 419404.9217559 J/kg and the stored h_su_0 is 293534.3441 J/kg (CoolSolve - EES = +125870.5776559 J/kg). Entropy is 3867.259359479 versus 5682.126158 J/kg-K. Specific volume is 0.8411720268193 versus 0.8414254791 m^3/kg (relative difference 3.0e-4). The enthalpy offset is separate from the missing root. No .sol for the native file. Fluid left as Air.
